purpose: Exploratory quality evaluation; this protocol does not establish native acceptance or population performance.

cutSafety.automaticAlignment: screening only; conflicting boundaries require human adjudication

caption.reference: independent human-checked transcript and word boundaries; report omissions separately

music.measurement: independently measure isolated dialogue and music contributions and report levels; no level alone proves intelligibility

listening: Record reviewer, media and context, original and edited samples, and pass/fail/uncertain with rationale. Unreviewed or uncertain is unavailable.
interpretation: Thresholds are exploratory engineering targets selected before new evaluation, not validated universal perceptual standards. Report denominators, exclusions, disagreements and uncertainty. Prior AMI observations are exploratory, not held-out evidence.
